Name: Electronic data/Business process
Notes: Combined representation of business operations/services and the digital information they produce, use, or rely on.
EN Notes: Combined representation of business operations/services and the digital information they produce, use, or rely on.
SK Notes: Kombinovaná reprezentácia podnikových činností/služieb a digitálnych informácií, ktoré vytvárajú, používajú alebo na ktorých sú závislé.

Name: Paper data
Notes: Physical information assets such as printed documents or records.
EN Notes: Physical information assets such as printed documents or records.
SK Notes: Fyzické informačné aktíva, ako sú vytlačené dokumenty alebo záznamy.

Name: Information system
Notes: A complete, integrated set of components for collecting, storing, and processing data. ICS/SCADA systems are included in this asset type.
EN Notes: A complete, integrated set of components for collecting, storing, and processing data. ICS/SCADA systems are included in this asset type.
SK Notes: Kompletný, integrovaný súbor komponentov na zber, ukladanie a spracovanie údajov. Do tohto typu aktív patria aj systémy ICS/SCADA.

Name: Server infrastructure
Notes: Physical or virtual servers that run and host applications, systems, and data essential for business processes.
EN Notes: Physical or virtual servers that run and host applications, systems, and data essential for business processes.
SK Notes: Fyzické alebo virtuálne servery, ktoré prevádzkujú a hostia aplikácie, systémy a údaje nevyhnutné pre obchodné procesy.

Name: Network infrastructure
Notes: Components such as switches, firewalls, routers, VPN gateways, IDS/IPS, load balancers, Wi-Fi access points, structured cabling that enable secure and reliable communication between systems and users.
EN Notes: Components such as switches, firewalls, routers, VPN gateways, IDS/IPS, load balancers, Wi-Fi access points, structured cabling that enable secure and reliable communication between systems and users.
SK Notes: Komponenty ako prepínače (switche), firewally, smerovače (routery), VPN brány, IDS/IPS, load balancery, Wi-Fi prístupové body, štruktúrovaná kabeláž, ktoré umožňujú bezpečnú a spoľahlivú komunikáciu medzi systémami a používateľmi.

Name: Virtualization platform
Notes: Technologies (e.g., hypervisors, container orchestration platforms, container runtimes, virtual desktop infrastructure) that abstract hardware and host virtualized systems.
EN Notes: Technologies (e.g., hypervisors, container orchestration platforms, container runtimes, virtual desktop infrastructure) that abstract hardware and host virtualized systems.
SK Notes: Technológie (napr. hypervízory, platformy na orchestráciu kontajnerov, kontajnerové runtime prostredia, infraštruktúra virtuálnych desktopov), ktoré abstrahujú hardvér a hostujú virtualizované systémy.

Name: Operating system
Notes: System software that manages hardware and software resources, forming the execution environment for applications. Covers client and server OSes.
EN Notes: System software that manages hardware and software resources, forming the execution environment for applications. Covers client and server OSes.
SK Notes: Systémový softvér, ktorý spravuje hardvérové a softvérové zdroje a tvorí vykonávacie prostredie pre aplikácie. Zahŕňa klientské aj serverové OS.

Name: Application software
Notes: Software that performs specific business or operational functions.
EN Notes: Software that performs specific business or operational functions.
SK Notes: Softvér, ktorý vykonáva konkrétne obchodné alebo prevádzkové funkcie.

Name: Cloud services
Notes: Third-party or internal cloud-based platforms/services in categories such as SaaS, PaaS, IaaS.
EN Notes: Third-party or internal cloud-based platforms/services in categories such as SaaS, PaaS, IaaS.
SK Notes: Cloudové platformy/služby tretích strán alebo interné cloudové služby v kategóriách ako SaaS, PaaS, IaaS.

Name: Data storage
Notes: Dedicated hardware or systems for persistent data retention (e.g., databases, file servers, SAN/NAS, object stores, backup/archiving systems).
EN Notes: Dedicated hardware or systems for persistent data retention (e.g., databases, file servers, SAN/NAS, object stores, backup/archiving systems).
SK Notes: Vyhradený hardvér alebo systémy na trvalé uchovávanie dát (napr. databázy, súborové servery, SAN/NAS, objektové úložiská, zálohovacie/archivačné systémy).

Name: Equipment, machines
Notes: Physical machinery, equipment, and industrial assets used in operations, including those with embedded non-networked control systems.
EN Notes: Physical machinery, equipment, and industrial assets used in operations, including those with embedded non-networked control systems.
SK Notes: Fyzické stroje, zariadenia a priemyselné aktíva používané v prevádzke, vrátane tých so zabudovanými nenetworkovanými riadiacimi systémami.

Name: IoT
Notes: Network-connected devices with embedded computing capabilities that interact with the physical environment or perform specialized functions. Includes facility/building systems (e.g., IP cameras, HVAC sensors, smart locks), office automation, and industrial control components (e.g., Programmable Logic Controllers, Remote Terminal Units).
EN Notes: Network-connected devices with embedded computing capabilities that interact with the physical environment or perform specialized functions. Includes facility/building systems (e.g., IP cameras, HVAC sensors, smart locks), office automation, and industrial control components (e.g., Programmable Logic Controllers, Remote Terminal Units).
SK Notes: Sieťovo pripojené zariadenia so zabudovanými výpočtovými schopnosťami, ktoré interagujú s fyzickým prostredím alebo vykonávajú špecializované funkcie. Zahŕňa systémy budov/prevádzky (napr. IP kamery, senzory HVAC, inteligentné zámky), kancelársku automatizáciu a komponenty priemyselného riadenia (napr. PLC – programovateľné logické automaty, RTU – vzdialené terminálové jednotky).

Name: PC
Notes: End user equipment - desktop computers used by personnel to access systems and data.
EN Notes: End user equipment - desktop computers used by personnel to access systems and data.
SK Notes: Koncové zariadenie používateľa – stolové počítače používané personálom na prístup k systémom a dátam.

Name: Laptop
Notes: End user equipment - portable computers used for mobile or flexible work.
EN Notes: End user equipment - portable computers used for mobile or flexible work.
SK Notes: Koncové zariadenie používateľa – prenosné počítače používané na mobilnú alebo flexibilnú prácu.

Name: Mobile devices
Notes: Smartphones and tablets that access, transmit, or store business information.
EN Notes: Smartphones and tablets that access, transmit, or store business information.
SK Notes: Smartfóny a tablety, ktoré pristupujú k podnikovým informáciám, prenášajú ich alebo ich ukladajú.

Name: Portable data media
Notes: Removable storage devices used for data transfer (e.g., USB sticks, external drives, CDs/DVDs, backup tapes used to transport or back up data).
EN Notes: Removable storage devices used for data transfer (e.g., USB sticks, external drives, CDs/DVDs, backup tapes used to transport or back up data).
SK Notes: Vymeniteľné úložné zariadenia používané na prenos dát (napr. USB kľúče, externé disky, CD/DVD, zálohovacie pásky používané na prenos alebo zálohovanie dát).

Name: Location
Notes: Physical facilities such as offices or data centers that host supporting systems or staff.
EN Notes: Physical facilities such as offices or data centers that host supporting systems or staff.
SK Notes: Fyzické priestory, ako kancelárie alebo dátové centrá, ktoré hostia podporné systémy alebo personál.

Name: Staff
Notes: High level groups of human resources that operate processes, interact with systems, and manage information.
EN Notes: High level groups of human resources that operate processes, interact with systems, and manage information.
SK Notes: Vysokoúrovňové skupiny ľudských zdrojov, ktoré vykonávajú procesy, pracujú so systémami a spravujú informácie.

Name: Other
Notes: Context-specific assets not captured in other asset types. Among other can include asset types like domain names, social media accounts, security certificates.
EN Notes: Context-specific assets not captured in other asset types. Among other can include asset types like domain names, social media accounts, security certificates.
SK Notes: Kontextovo špecifické aktíva, ktoré nie sú zachytené v iných typoch aktív. Môže zahŕňať napr. doménové mená, účty na sociálnych sieťach, bezpečnostné certifikáty.
